svg.title: Action expansion: fixed bank-1 winners scored on bank 2
svg.desc: Horizontal log-scale candidate-to-torch ratios. Blue circles show old actions; orange squares show new actions. Lower is faster. Missing ratios are marked unscored. Labels map to named workloads in the linked summary.

g.text: Action expansion — bank-1 selection / bank-2 scoring
Candidate / same-session torch; smaller is better. Named workloads retained; no bank-2 oracle selection.
Descriptive single-device timing; quantile spread is in JSON, not statistical uncertainty. Union winner and failures are in JSON.
